text: Tree ensembles versus deep learning on tabular data
path_note: Empirical and CPU-scale (gradient boosting and small MLPs on a few public datasets run in seconds to minutes), but the loop has no harness or sandbox image for it: this tests whether the second-problem machinery of this increment generalises.
good_question: One specific question about when gradient-boosted trees beat neural networks on tabular data (dataset size, feature types, noise), small enough to test on a few public datasets on a CPU.
